cases.description: The agent should create a file, edit one exact string, and report completion.
cases.prompt: Use write_file to create .vyrn/eval-runs/edit-target.txt with exactly: status=PENDING. Then use edit_file to replace PENDING with COMPLETE in that file. After edit_file succeeds, reply with exactly VYRN_EDIT_DONE.

cases.description: The agent should use batch to create a file, and a deterministic command assertion verifies the side effect.
cases.prompt: Use the batch tool exactly once to run: printf VYRN_BATCH_FILE_MARKER_2026 > .vyrn/eval-runs/batch-created.txt. After the command succeeds, reply with exactly VYRN_BATCH_FILE_MARKER_2026.

cases.description: The agent should follow a no-tool instruction for a direct answer.
cases.prompt: Do not use any tools. Reply with exactly VYRN_NO_TOOL_DONE.
